% The display/float spacing distinction is identical in one-column mode.
\documentclass[onecolumn,nominted]{pt-article}
\title{One-column Table Spacing}

\begin{document}

\noindent PTSTANDALONEBEFORE\par
\begin{tblr}{hlines,vlines,colspec={X}}
    PTSTANDALONECELL
\end{tblr}
\noindent PTSTANDALONEAFTER\par

\clearpage

\noindent PTFLOATBEFORE\par
\begin{table}[H]
    \centering
    \begin{tblr}{hlines,vlines,colspec={X}}
        PTFLOATCELL
    \end{tblr}
    \caption{PTFLOATCAPTION}
\end{table}
\noindent PTFLOATAFTER\par

\end{document}
